gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/final recommended=1

This PR adds an Export CSV button to the reports page that downloads every column shown in the table, with paging capped so an export never holds the request open indefinitely; you are the author. The button, the full column set, and the paging limit behind the speed target are covered here, the under-5-seconds speed on production data can only be checked after merge, and email delivery and audit events are assigned by the spec to acme/mailer.

Nothing blocks merging. The tests check the header row, every table column, the paging cap, the deadline, and the not-found response for an unknown report, and those tests passed in CI on the commit being reviewed. One smaller point does not block merging: the export pages through rows with its own loop instead of reusing the shared paging helper in lib/page.ts (src/api/export.ts, line 31), and fix nits can take it. You cannot approve your own PR, so approve is not offered.

I recommend merge because nothing blocks it and the checks passed on this exact commit.

Pick one:
1. merge - squash-merge the PR into its base branch. [recommended]
2. fix nits - have a helper switch the export to the shared paging helper, review and push that change, watch the checks once, then return here.
3. stop - leave the PR open and the checkout as it is.
